subject: GreenBank private network pilot — architecture & resourcing check-in
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GreenBank pilot: initial ask + compliance redlines

Folks — looping you in on a request from GreenBank. Short summary: they want a 3-month pilot that combines a VPC-isolated control plane + an on-prem inference appliance in their datacenter. Requirements called out: dedicated KMS/HSM integration, SOC2 evidence for data segregation, and an option for an airgapped delivery.

They've asked for architecture feasibility and a resourcing plan by EOD next Wednesday (9/22). Can infra & security confirm what the minimal gated deliverables are (network diagram, connectivity requirements, required FTE for setup/oncall, compliance artifacts)?

I've attached the initial ask from their security team (SOC2 list) and a very rough cost primer.

Next steps I suggest: 1) quick sync Wednesday 9/15 4pm PT (30m) to triage, 2) share a one-page feasibility note by 9/22.

Thanks — Adi

--
Aditya Rao
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GreenBank pilot: initial ask + compliance redlines

Thanks Adi. I can take point on the feasibility note but will need clear owners for three buckets: Networking (Karthik), Security/Compliance (Kim), and Ops/resourcing (Marcus).

I've sketched a minimal deliverable list and attached a quick network-diagram (network-diagram-v2.pdf) and a cost workbook (cost-estimate-greenbank.xlsx) — these are deliberately conservative. Questions I have now:
- Is GreenBank expecting us to manage the appliance (break/fix + OS patching) or hand off a fully configured device?
- Do they require our KMS to be brought into their HSM, or do they want us to call their KMS via API? If strict HSM integration is required, that materially changes timeline.
- Do we have any spare headcount for a 24/7 oncall window for the first 90 days? If not, we should price in a contractor.

I'll coordinate a short 30m cross-functional sync later today at 4pm PT. Please bring any redlines you want on the SOC2 list.

Sooj

--
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GreenBank pilot: initial ask + compliance redlines

Appreciate the attach. Quick notes from Security/Compliance perspective (high level):
- SOC2: we'll need to provide evidence for access reviews, network segmentation, encryption-in-transit + at-rest, and key lifecycle management. The "soc2-evidence-ask.docx" covers their template.
- KMS/HSM: GreenBank's security mentions HSM-backed keys for key signing. We need to confirm if we support HSM logical wrapping (PKCS#11) in our private offering. If not, recommend we propose an architecture where keys are provisioned by GreenBank and we integrate via TLS-mutual auth and remote-sign API calls.
- Audit logs: they want 1 year retention and indexed search. We can provide logs but retention and storage cost must be explicit.

Action items for us:
1) Karthik — validate whether current private runtime supports PKCS#11 or HSM connectors (timeline + effort).
2) Marcus — estimate SRE/Ops FTEs for provisioning, first 90-day oncall, and a runbook handoff.
3) Soojin/Aditya — decide customer-owned vs Redwood-managed KMS option for proposal.

If GreenBank insists on full HSM-integration embodied in our appliance, we should mark that as high-risk and request an exception to normal delivery SLA.

Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Staff Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GreenBank pilot: initial ask + compliance redlines

Quick update from Networking/Runtime: we do not currently ship an HSM module in the appliance. We have two feasible paths:

A) Customer-managed keys: GreenBank provisions HSM and we call their signing service over a tightly scoped API. Pros: minimal infra change, quicker (~3 weeks). Cons: depends on customer's infra and network reliability.

B) Partner HSM integration: work with Cumulus Cloud partner to broker keys via a managed HSM cluster that supports PKCS#11. This requires development (~6-8 weeks) and a small infra uplift.

Connectivity notes: for on-prem appliance we need two outbound flows (control plane to Redwoods control plane, and metrics/export to their SIEM). For VPC isolation we can place control-plane endpoints in a private subnet and allow limited, whitelisted egress.

I'm tagging JIRA-PRIVNET-482 for the engineering work and will add a short tech debt spike if we go B. Marcus, I need an estimate for provisioning windows and whether we have a contractor bench to cover the initial 90-day ops runway.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Pierce <apierce@greenbank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-17T07:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GreenBank pilot: initial ask + compliance redlines

Thanks team. A couple clarifications from GreenBank Security before we kick the pilot:
- We prefer option B (partner HSM) if Redwood can guarantee FIPS 140-2 validation and provide an architecture diagram showing how keys are stored and who has access.
- We expect the pilot to be able to demonstrate data segmentation and no-commingling with other customers within the first 30 days.
- Timeline is important — can you share a realistic delivery ETA for a minimal pilot (customer-managed keys vs partner HSM)?

We can be flexible on the support model (managed vs handed-off) as long as responsibilities are explicit.

Alex
Director, IT Security
GreenBank Financial
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-22T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GreenBank pilot: initial ask + compliance redlines — feasibility note attached

Folks — attached is the one-page feasibility note and the cost workbook with a line item for contractor coverage (cost-estimate-greenbank.xlsx). Summary:
- Minimal viable pilot (customer-managed keys, no HSM integration) — ETA 3 weeks for provisioning + 1 week test = 4 weeks. Requires 0.5 FTE Eng + 0.25 FTE Security + 1 contractor for first 90 days oncall.
- Partner HSM path (Cumulus broker) — ETA 8–10 weeks, engineering effort ~1.5 FTE for 6 weeks, increased infra costs (+monthly managed HSM).
- Compliance: we can satisfy SOC2 evidence items within pilot scope if GreenBank provides inbound attestations (access lists) and we get read access to their audit logs. Retention costs are explicit in the workbook.

Open asks before we formalize proposal:
1) Adi/Soojin — confirm which KMS option GreenBank prefers so we can lock timelines.
2) Kimberly — confirm we can deliver the SOC2 evidence set with the suggested approach (customer-provisioned keys + remote-sign API).
3) Adi — confirm commercial willingness to fund initial contractor coverage and managed HSM if GreenBank chooses option B.

I'll place this note in the Drive folder and convert the workbook to a shared sheet.

Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Head of SRE Operations
Redwood Inference
